title: Unit 14: Hydrocarbons — Syllabus Overview
notes:
• Saturated Hydrocarbons (Alkanes): Preparation (reduction, Wurtz reaction, decarboxylation, catalytic hydrogenation), substitution reactions, oxidation of ethane
  • Unsaturated Hydrocarbons (Alkenes & Alkynes): Alkenes preparation (dehydration, dehydrohalogenation), addition reactions (Markovnikov's addition, peroxide effect); Alkynes preparation and addition/acidic reactions
  • Tests of unsaturation: Bromine water test and Baeyer's test
  • Comparative physical properties of alkanes, alkenes, and alkynes
  • Kolbe's electrolysis methods
